# Lingendo

Lingendo is a Polish-language demonstration platform for learning vocabulary with flashcards, spaced repetition and AI-assisted example sentences.

## Project status

- Public portfolio and engineering project by Grzegorz Wawrzeń.
- Demonstration environment, not a commercial product.
- Demo data may be reset periodically; users should not enter sensitive data.

## Public pages

- Home: https://www.lingendo.app/
- How it works: https://www.lingendo.app/how-it-works
- FAQ: https://www.lingendo.app/faq
- Project description: https://gwawrzen.pl/projekty/lingendo/
- Source code: https://github.com/WGrzesiek/lingendo
